summary: Azul S.A. filed a Form 6-K on October 7, 2026, disclosing that Brazil's CADE tribunal unanimously approved American Airlines' US$100 million investment via exercise of subscription warrants — 3,958,429,263,261 Series 1 warrants (AZUL11) and 5,449,247 Series 4 warrants (AZUL19) — giving American roughly 8% of total and voting capital. CADE's decision, including a Merger Control Agreement, publishes in coming days, after which commercial agreements between American and Azul take effect. No price per share, premium, or outside advisor named. Watch warrant conversion mechanics, filing of the Merger Control Agreement, and any follow-on proxy or governance terms.
